description: Read a recorded review: its date, notes and decisions, and the snapshot of the matrix taken when it was recorded (each element with its status, value, target, progress, health and latest reading, and the completeness score). Use it to see what a decision was based on, even after a figure was corrected. snapshot is null for a review not recorded yet, or recorded before snapshots existed. Review ids come from get_agenda (recentReviews, items).
name: get_review
title: Get a recorded review
